Name: Morris is a Frog
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
UPDATE: Version 1.10 allow compatibility with Marry Morris *adds 10 unique portraits, flower dance tiny frog outfit, red tie for wedding apparel and kissing animation*

Do you not like that creep who runs Joja corp in Pelican Town? Well I've got the cutest, tiniest replacement for you! A little frog named Morris can now be the head of Joja Corp in your stardew world.

This mod changes the character sprites and portraits of Morris to look like a cute little frog.

Need MORE frog in your town? This mod is COMPATIBLE with Morris Redeemed by Si. If you want your little frog to live in the community centre, participate in festivals, and be more of a part of the town, then try out this portrait pack combined with Si's Morris Redeemed.
VERSION 1.1.0 also now COMPATIBLE with Marry Morris by Yoshimax!

NOT compatible at the moment with SVE. Thank you to eXCiLee for testing this out for me <3 I will be updating this/ creating a 2nd version for SVE :3

there's not much more to say about this one! He is just a little guy. (but don't call him short he is very sensitive)



WHAT YOU NEED:
-Content Patcher + SMAPI

WHAT YOU NEED TO DO:
1. make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed
2. Download my file + unzip it into your "mods" folder. 
your town will now have a super cute joja CEO!

Please, if you have any advice, questions, thoughts, anything-- i'd love to see it in a comment!! 

WHAT ELSE AM I WORKING ON?
-for this mod I WILL update it/link to a new mod where I make it compatible with SVE! 
- I have a big dialogue expansion for my Black Butler Sebastian Mod! Its coming along really well and is close to completion
- I have a new character portrait and sprite mod I'm working on for Sam. He is looking really cool and has a slight fantasy vibe to him, while keeping his late-teens type vibe, has lip rings and an anime aesthetic. If anybody knows Black Butler- he is based off of Blavat Sky :)

CREDITS:
HUGE credit to AirynS! Thanks to their amazing mod "Professional Morris" I was able to find out how to make my little frog sprites show up in the game. They did a wonderful job with their Morris mod and theirs is even compatible with Marry Morris as well as Morris Redeemed. Please check it out!
